answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the zenith queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The spiral index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 925 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ocean. The bill scales 36 fold, not the vote. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
